title: 黑铁遗珍 | Black Iron Relics
scope: 100 design archetypes × 5 rarities = 500 named equipment records
origin: Original Diablo-inspired dark-fantasy design; not canonical Blizzard item data.
icon_source_note: Cropped from previously generated visual concept sheets. These are NOT mechanically verified 6x6 or 12x12 true-pixel source sprites; original sheets depict 120 cells per rarity, 100 cells per rarity were selected.

equip_rules.hands: 装备双手武器时无法再装备主手/盾牌副手；箭袋有独立槽，仅装备弓/弩时生效；允许同时装备2枚戒指，不可装备超过1件同名暗金物品。

drop_rules: 概率表仅适用于品质合格的已触发装备掉落，不代表每个怪物都有装备掉落。精英/首领可按难度和保底调整；暗金专属来源需二次检查。
